test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Taxes like gift tax, wealth tax etc are also referred to as which type of taxes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Direct taxes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct taxes** are taxes that are paid directly to the government by the individual or organization on whom it is imposed.
 
• Examples of direct taxes include **gift tax, wealth tax, income tax,** etc.
 
• These taxes are generally progressive, meaning the rate increases as the taxable amount increases.
 
• Direct taxes are considered more equitable because they are based on the ability-to-pay principle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Direct taxes are administered and collected by the **Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)** in India.
 
• The CBDT is a part of the Department of Revenue under the Ministry of Finance.
 
• Direct taxes play a critical role in the revenue generation of a country and are used for various public services and infrastructure development.
 
• Unlike indirect taxes, direct taxes cannot be shifted to another person or entity.
 
• Compliance with direct tax regulations is mandatory for all eligible taxpayers to avoid penalties and legal actions.
